title: MatFormer granularity Mirror views
hypothesis: A tiny per-layer/per-granularity orthogonal View fitted after nested-width supernet training improves held-out quality of every nested granularity over vanilla nested sharing, while using <=50% of independent-model payload; this improvement must exceed equal-budget FiLM and rank-1 LoRA controls to count as Mirror-specific.
physical_object: Two-layer nested-width MLP with width 64 supernetwork and 10-class output; active channels are prefixes at widths 16,32,64.
mirror_coordinate: Per-layer, per-granularity 4-angle Givens transform over the first 8 active hidden coordinates immediately before each layer output/head; layer codes are stored per selected width.
logical_multiplicity: Three nested-width models (16,32,64) from one physical supernetwork.

development.selection: minimum mean validation NLL over all widths and methods
development.allowed_tuning: select only base learning rate in frozen grid

storage.authority: actual torch.save full inference-bank payload bytes

success_gate: In all three fresh worlds, Mirror improves mean accuracy over vanilla nested baseline by >=1pp, remains within 2pp of independent, and payload <=50% independent; Mirror-specific requires >=1pp over FiLM at byte-near cost (within 15%) or >=10% fewer bytes than FiLM at <=0.5pp loss.
failure_gate: Miss shared-vs-independent quality/storage gate in >=2 fresh worlds, or FiLM/LoRA matches/dominates Mirror at equal/lower payload and correction compute.
boundaries: small nested MLP mechanism screen, not MatFormer transformer reproduction
fixed updates are not capacity evidence
no unseen mixed-granularity configurations; these belong to MA-372
